_readme: Worn-jersey log for the 30 NBA team schedule posts and /nba-tracker/<team>. Read by scripts/gen-nba-schedule-tables.mjs and lib/winterTrackerIndex.ts.
Key = '<YYYY-MM-DD> <AWAY>@<HOME>' using the tricodes in scripts/data/nba-schedule-2026-27.txt (game date in US Eastern).
score = final {away, home}; ot: true for overtime. A key with no score is not treated as played.

Per side: call = the jersey worn, spelled exactly like the announced file (Association White, Icon Edition, Statement Edition, City Edition, Classic Edition, ...). detail = optional short qualifier shown after the call (e.g. 'gold ring-night trim'). note = internal only.
A side left out falls back to that club's announced call (scripts/data/nba-announced-uniforms-2026-27.json). A call that differs from the announced one renders as 'Changed' on the schedule post.
confirmed: true = we SAW both jerseys (team game photos, ESPN highlights). Unconfirmed played rows show the score with the announced call and read 'Final', never 'Worn'.

Nightly pass: node scripts/nba-worn-log.mjs <YYYYMMDD> (adds finals, pre-fills worn = announced, confirmed:false), check photos, override any changed call + set confirmed:true, then node scripts/gen-nba-schedule-tables.mjs.
